messages:
julia-cs: customer reports a sudden spike of 502/504s hitting hosted API around 14:22 UTC, ~20% of requests failing. client sees \"upstream reset\". ticket #8342, customer on embeddings route.

marta-support: can you paste a sample curl + any trace ids? customer says it reproduces during large batch embeds.

julia-cs: here is the curl they ran:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{\"input\":[\"...\"],\"batch_size\":64}'
```
response snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: req-01F9K2... (trace: trace-9a7d)
```

liam-eng-sre: I see ingress spike at 2026-03-17T14:21:32Z, envoy h2 stream resets and 502s. Looks like upstream auth/cache latency jumped and caused proxy timeouts to model-workers. Pulling envoy stats + upstream histograms now.

cheng-observability: grafana shows auth-backend p95 latency jump from ~80ms to ~3.2s at 14:21, retry rate +4x and connection errors rising. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/edge/ingress?panelId=7

liam-eng-sre: triage commands I ran on an ingress node:
```
kubectl -n ingress exec -it deploy/edge-proxy -- envoy-stats | rg upstream_cx_
kubectl -n ingress logs deploy/edge-proxy -c envoy --tail=200 | rg \"stream reset|upstream reset\"
```
I also scaled auth-cache by +2 replicas to reduce backpressure.

marta-support: customer provided traces: trace-9a7d, trace-9b1c, trace-9b2f. They report this mostly on embeddings with batch_size=64.

liam-eng-sre: reproduced locally with loadtest (64 batch, 200 rps, 30s) -> got 502s. Hypothesis: h2 WINDOW_UPDATE / flow-control exhaustion between edge-proxy and upstream (auth/cache or model-workers) when large payloads + connection reuse happen, leading to ENVOY stream resets. Proposed mitigation: adjust envoy per-connection stream window and increase upstream connection pool sizes for auth and model-worker pools.

cheng-observability: logs contain repeated lines: `upstream response timeout` and `ENVOY_STREAM_RESET` with reason `FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR` for the traces listed. saving traces to traces/trace-9a7d etc.

liam-eng-sre: short-term mitigation rolled 14:45 UTC: bumped envoy upstream stream window, increased auth-cache replicas, and applied a route override: `max_concurrent_streams=32` for /v1/embeddings. Roll id: roll-2026-03-17-edge-502-mitigate.

marta-support: asked customer to temporarily reduce embeddings batch_size to 16 as a workaround while we monitor.

julia-cs: customer confirmed error rate dropped to near-zero after the patch + batch reduction. they'll run larger tests tomorrow and report.

liam-eng-sre: follow-ups: if it reoccurs we'll open an incident postmortem, add h2 windowing e2e tests, and consider per-route concurrency controls and smarter batching recommendations. I'll watch key metrics for 24h.

deploy-bot: Deploy roll-2026-03-17-edge-502-mitigate succeeded (7/7 pods, 17s) :rocket:

cheng-observability: saved relevant spans/traces -> traces/trace-9a7d, traces/trace-9b1c, traces/trace-9b2f.

marta-support: closing thread in slack, moving ticket to monitoring and follow-up. :white_check_mark:
